section_summary.extract_value: This Procedure section describes the data collection methodology for a study conducted in Greater London, United Kingdom. Participants were recruited opportunistically from public locations and completed an anonymous paper-and-pencil survey in a quiet setting, with demographic items presented last and the order of other scales semi-randomized. The section emphasizes ethical approval, informed consent, voluntary participation, and debriefing, but does not provide sample size, demographic characteristics, or statistical results.
